attchmntText: Palred Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Intimation - Newspaper Publication of Financial Results for the Quarter and HalfYear ended 30.09.2026".
voiceSummary: Palred Technologies published financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board approved the results on 13 November 2026. Inference Platforms Limited also reported results for the same period, approved by its Board on 13 November 2026. Tieramet Limited announced its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board approved these results on 13 November 2026. Canara Bank, Peerzadiguda Branch, will auction a Maruti Suzuki vehicle on 30 November 2026. The reserve price is Rs. 3,24,000. The earnest money deposit is Rs. 32,400. Canara Bank, Chandrayanagutta Branch, will auction gold ornaments on 30 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

attchmntText: Palred Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Palred Technologies Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting held on November 13, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 73.7 Lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 135.34 Lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 37.50 Lakhs for the quarter and 75.00 Lakhs for the half year. The consolidated results show a loss after tax of 100.9 Lakhs for the quarter and 95.39 Lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was 205.2 Lakhs for the quarter and 423.86 Lakhs for the half year. The statutory auditors, MSKC and Associates LLP, completed a limited review of the standalone results.
